description: Inbox templates for club life: training, upgrades, packs, dupes, energy, morale, scout tips, board notes. FM-straight chrome, whimsy in the words. Placeholders: {player} {tier} {coins} {feat}.

templates.headline: TRAINING COMPLETE
templates.body: {player} steps up to {tier}. The whole yard clapped.

templates.headline: TRAINING REPORT
templates.body: {player} hit every cone. {tier} looks well earned.

templates.headline: NEW TIER EARNED
templates.body: {player} trained hard for this. {tier}, done and dusted.

templates.headline: SESSION OVER
templates.body: {player} stayed late again. That is {tier} form.

templates.headline: COACH'S NOTES
templates.body: Textbook week from {player}. {tier}, signed and sealed.

templates.headline: CARD UPGRADED
templates.body: {player} shines in {tier} now. Hold it up to the light.

templates.headline: UPGRADE NEWS
templates.body: Same {player}, better sparkle. {tier} looks the part.

templates.headline: SHINY NEW TIER
templates.body: {player} just went {tier}. The binder looks better already.

templates.headline: UPGRADE COMPLETE
templates.body: Your {player} is now {tier}. No coins spent. Lucky day.

templates.headline: LADDER CLIMBED
templates.body: One step up for {player}. {tier} today, who knows tomorrow.

templates.headline: PACK EARNED
templates.body: {feat} complete. A pack is waiting in your tray.

templates.headline: PRIZE DELIVERY
templates.body: One pack, earned the honest way. Open it when ready.

templates.headline: TRAY UPDATE
templates.body: A new pack just landed. {feat} made it happen.

templates.headline: YOU EARNED THIS
templates.body: No rush. The pack will wait right there in your tray.

templates.headline: DUPLICATE SWAPPED
templates.body: Two of {player} is one too many. {coins} coins to the club.

templates.headline: SWAP COMPLETE
templates.body: The spare {player} found a new home. {coins} coins in.

templates.headline: COIN NEWS
templates.body: A duplicate {player} became {coins} coins. Tidy business.

templates.headline: BINDER TIDIED
templates.body: One {player} stays, one goes. {coins} coins for the jar.

templates.headline: FITNESS REPORT
templates.body: {player} is running on empty. A round off fixes everything.

templates.headline: REST ADVISED
templates.body: {player} gave everything out there. Fresh legs beat tired ones.

templates.headline: SQUAD ROTATION
templates.body: Tired boots, heavy touches. Give {player} a breather.

templates.headline: FRESH LEGS ALERT
templates.body: {player} is back to full battery. Ready when you are.

templates.headline: MOOD WATCH
templates.body: {player} is ON FIRE. Keep that name on the team sheet.

templates.headline: DRESSING ROOM NEWS
templates.body: {player} WANTS TO PLAY. A start would fix that frown.

templates.headline: A QUIET WEEK
templates.body: {player} is feeling COLD. One goal turns it all around.

templates.headline: ALL SMILES
templates.body: Good mood in the yard. {player} led the singing.

templates.headline: SCOUT'S TIP
templates.body: Keep an eye on {player}. {tier} would change matches.

templates.headline: ONE TO TRAIN
templates.body: {player} is ready for more. {tier} is within reach.

templates.headline: TALENT SPOTTED
templates.body: I watched {player} train twice. Trust me on this one.

templates.headline: TRAINING TIP
templates.body: {coins} coins takes {player} to {tier}. Money well spent.

templates.headline: FROM THE SCOUT
templates.body: {player} has that look. {tier} next, mark my words.

templates.headline: FROM THE BOARD
templates.body: The board met at breakfast. Verdict: proud of you.

templates.headline: BOARD EXPECTATIONS
templates.body: Win or learn. That is the whole plan. We like the plan.

templates.headline: NOTE FROM UPSTAIRS
templates.body: The board suggests chasing {feat}. Biscuits either way.

templates.headline: CLUB VISION
templates.body: Keep training, keep smiling. Trophies follow teams like that.
